{"items": [
{"type": "reference", "text": "34 CFR part 77", "cited_instrument": "34 CFR Part 77"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "General Education Provisions Act", "cited_instrument": "General Education Provisions Act"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "Department of Education Organization Act (DEOA)", "cited_instrument": "Department of Education Organization Act"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "section 439 of the General Education Provisions Act", "cited_instrument": "General Education Provisions Act section 439"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "Section 418A of the Higher Education Act of 1965", "cited_instrument": "Higher Education Act of 1965 section 418A"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "The Rehabilitation Act of 1973", "cited_instrument": "Rehabilitation Act of 1973"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "Title IV of the Housing Act of 1950", "cited_instrument": "Housing Act of 1950 Title IV"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "part 206", "cited_instrument": "34 CFR Part 206"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "part 614", "cited_instrument": "34 CFR Part 614"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "§ 98.5", "cited_instrument": "34 CFR 98.5"},
{"type": "definition", "term": "Act", "text": "Act means the General Education Provisions Act."},
{"type": "definition", "term": "Office", "text": "Office means the information and investigation office specified in § 98.5."},
{"type": "definition", "term": "research or experimentation program or project", "text": "For the purpose of this part research or experimentation program or project means any program or project in any program under § 98.1 (a) or (b) that is designed to explore or develop new or unproven teaching methods or techniques."},
{"type": "definition", "term": "children", "text": "For the purpose of the section children means persons not above age 21 who are enrolled in a program under § 98.1 (a) or (b) not above the elementary or secondary education level, as determined under State law."},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "All instructional material—including teachers' manuals, films, tapes, or other supplementary instructional material—which will be used in connection with any research or experimentation program or project shall be available for inspection by the parents or guardians of the children engaged in such program or project.", "force": "obligation", "binds": null, "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": null}
]}

{"items": [
{"type":"obligation","text":"No student shall be required, as part of any program specified in § 98.1 (a) or (b), to submit without prior consent to psychiatric examination, testing, or treatment, or psychological examination, testing, or treatment, in which the primary purpose is to reveal information concerning one or more of the following:","force":"prohibition","binds":null,"responsible_party_stated":false,"mechanism_stated":"without prior consent"},
{"type":"definition","term":"prior consent","text":"As used in paragraph (a) of this section, prior consent means:"},
{"type":"definition","term":"Psychiatric or psychological examination or test","text":"Psychiatric or psychological examination or test means a method of obtaining information, including a group activity, that is not directly related to academic instruction and that is designed to elicit information about attitudes, habits, traits, opinions, beliefs or feelings; and"},
{"type":"definition","term":"Psychiatric or psychological treatment","text":"Psychiatric or psychological treatment means an activity involving the planned, systematic use of methods or techniques that are not directly related to academic instruction and that is designed to affect behavioral, emotional, or attitudinal characteristics of an individual or group."},
{"type":"reference","text":"§ 98.1 (a) or (b)","cited_instrument":"34 CFR 98.1"},
{"type":"reference","text":"20 U.S.C. 1232h(b)","cited_instrument":"20 U.S.C. 1232h(b)"},
{"type":"obligation","text":"The Secretary has designated an office to provide information about the requirements of section 439 of the Act, and to investigate, process, and review complaints that may be filed concerning alleged violations of the provisions of the section.","force":"obligation","binds":"The Secretary","responsible_party_stated":true,"mechanism_stated":null},
{"type":"reference","text":"section 439 of the Act","cited_instrument":"Section 439 of the General Education Provisions Act"},
{"type":"reference","text":"20 U.S.C. 1231e-3(a)(1), 1232h","cited_instrument":"20 U.S.C. 1231e-3(a)(1), 1232h"},
{"type":"obligation","text":"The Secretary may require the recipient to submit reports containing information necessary to resolve complaints under section 439 of the Act and the regulations in this part.","force":"permission","binds":"The Secretary","responsible_party_stated":true,"mechanism_stated":null},
{"type":"reference","text":"20 U.S.C. 1221e-3(a)(1), 1232h","cited_instrument":"20 U.S.C. 1221e-3(a)(1), 1232h"},
{"type":"obligation","text":"Only a student or a parent or guardian of a student directly affected by a violation under Section 439 of the Act may file a complaint under this part.","force":"prohibition","binds":"a student or a parent or guardian of a student directly affected by a violation","responsible_party_stated":true,"mechanism_stated":null},
{"type":"obligation","text":"The complaint must be submitted in writing to the Office.","force":"obligation","binds":"The complaint","responsible_party_stated":false,"mechanism_stated":"in writing to the Office"},
{"type":"obligation","text":"The complaint filed under paragraph (a) of this section must— (1) Contain specific allegations of fact giving reasonable cause to believe that a violation of either § 98.3 or § 98.4 exists; and","force":"obligation","binds":"The complaint","responsible_party_stated":false,"mechanism_stated":null},
{"type":"obligation","text":"The complaint filed under paragraph (a) of this section must— (2) Include evidence of attempted resolution of the complaint at the local level (and at the State level if a State complaint resolution process exists), including the names of local and State officials contacted and significant dates in the attempted resolution process.","force":"obligation","binds":"The complaint","responsible_party_stated":false,"mechanism_stated":null},
{"type":"reference","text":"§ 98.3","cited_instrument":"34 CFR 98.3"},
{"type":"reference","text":"§ 98.4","cited_instrument":"34 CFR 98.4"},
{"type":"obligation","text":"The Office investigates each complaint which the Office receives that meets the requirements of this section to determine whether the recipient or contractor failed to comply with the provisions of section 439 of the Act.","force":"obligation","binds":"The Office","responsible_party_stated":true,"mechanism_stated":"to determine whether the recipient or contractor failed to comply with the provisions of section 439 of the Act"}
]}

{"items": [
{"type": "obligation", "text": "If the Office receives a complaint that meets the requirements of § 98.7, it provides written notification to the complainant and the recipient or contractor against which the violation has been alleged that the complaint has been received.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "the Office", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "provides written notification to the complainant and the recipient or contractor"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "§ 98.7", "cited_instrument": "34 CFR 98.7"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "The notice to the recipient or contractor under paragraph (a) of this section must: (1) Include the substance of the alleged violation;", "force": "obligation", "binds": "The notice to the recipient or contractor", "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "The notice to the recipient or contractor under paragraph (a) of this section must: (2) Inform the recipient or contractor that the Office will investigate the complaint and that the recipient or contractor may submit a written response to the complaint.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "The notice to the recipient or contractor", "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "the recipient or contractor may submit a written response to the complaint", "force": "permission", "binds": "the recipient or contractor", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "submit a written response to the complaint"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "20 U.S.C. 1221e-3(A)(1), 1232h", "cited_instrument": "20 U.S.C. 1221e-3(a)(1), 1232h"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "The Office may permit the parties to submit further written or oral arguments or information.", "force": "permission", "binds": "the Office", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Following its investigations, the Office provides to the complainant and recipient or contractor written notice of its findings and the basis for its findings.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "the Office", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "written notice of its findings and the basis for its findings"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "If the Office finds that the recipient or contractor has not complied with section 439 of the Act, the Office includes in its notice under paragraph (b) of this section:", "force": "obligation", "binds": "the Office", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "reference", "text": "section 439 of the Act", "cited_instrument": "General Education Provisions Act section 439"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "A statement of the specific steps that the Secretary recommends the recipient or contractor take to comply; and", "force": "obligation", "binds": "the Office", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Provides a reasonable period of time, given all of the circumstances of the case, during which the recipient or contractor may comply voluntarily.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "the Office", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "a reasonable period of time, given all of the circumstances of the case"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "20 U.S.C. 1221e-3(a)(1), 1232h", "cited_instrument": "20 U.S.C. 1221e-3(a)(1), 1232h"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "If the recipient or contractor does not comply during the period of time set under § 98.9(c), the Secretary may either:", "force": "permission", "binds": "the Secretary", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "period of time set under § 98.9(c)"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "§ 98.9(c)", "cited_instrument": "34 CFR 98.9(c)"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "For a recipient, take an action authorized under 34 CFR part 78, including:", "force": "permission", "binds": "the Secretary", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "Issuing a notice of intent to terminate funds under 34 CFR 78.21"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "34 CFR part 78", "cited_instrument": "34 CFR Part 78"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "34 CFR 78.21", "cited_instrument": "34 CFR 78.21"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "200.94(b)", "cited_instrument": "34 CFR 200.94(b)"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "298.45(b)", "cited_instrument": "34 CFR 298.45(b)"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "34 CFR 78.31", "cited_instrument": "34 CFR 78.31"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "200.94(c)", "cited_instrument": "34 CFR 200.94(c)"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "298.45(c)", "cited_instrument": "34 CFR 298.45(c)"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "For a contractor, direct the contracting officer to take an appropriate action authorized under the Federal Acquisition Regulations, including either:", "force": "permission", "binds": "the Secretary", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "Issuing a notice to suspend operations under 48 CFR 12.5"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "Federal Acquisition Regulations", "cited_instrument": "Federal Acquisition Regulation (48 CFR)"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "48 CFR 12.5", "cited_instrument": "48 CFR 12.5"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "48 CFR 49.102", "cited_instrument": "48 CFR 49.102"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "§ 98.9", "cited_instrument": "34 CFR 98.9"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "If, after an investigation under § 98.9, the Secretary finds that a recipient or contractor has complied voluntarily with section 439 of the Act, the Secretary provides the complainant and the recipient or contractor written notice of the decision and the basis for the decision.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "the Secretary", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "written notice of the decision and the basis for the decision"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "20 U.S.C. 1221e-3(a)(1), 1232h", "cited_instrument": "20 U.S.C. 1221e-3(a)(1), 1232h"}
]}
